card.name: Word just before "threshold" (seizure threshold)
card.fires_on: The word right before "threshold" in phrases like "lower the seizure threshold" or "lower the convulsive threshold". Also the "th" piece in "no-threshold" just before "reshold".

modes.label: Seizure threshold
modes.description: The word seizure or the "ulsive" part of convulsive, after "lower the", right before threshold.
